captions.detailed: A super-telephoto prime camera lens featuring a long light-grey alloy barrel, a dark-blue front glass element, and a grey bayonet rear mount plate. It includes a wide, ribbed black focus ring situated near the front element group and a black tripod collar with a flat mounting foot at its mid-section. The focus ring rotates continuously around the barrel axis, and the tripod collar rotates on a continuous revolute joint to allow switching between landscape and portrait orientations.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a super-telephoto prime camera lens with a long light-grey barrel, a blue front lens element, and a grey rear bayonet mount. Incorporate a ribbed black focus ring capable of continuous rotation near the front, and a rotating black tripod collar with a mounting foot on a continuous joint at the center of the barrel.
captions.factory: The lens is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The main barrel is built by combining cylinder primitives and a lofted/tapered section for the main body, topped with a blue glass cylinder at the front and a grey bayonet mount at the rear. A separate focus ring is modeled as a cylinder with arrayed ridges for the ribbed texture, attached to the barrel via a continuous revolute joint. The tripod collar is created by combining a hollow cylinder ring with a rectangular box foot, connected to the barrel with a second continuous revolute joint.
